title.note: Game title, glossary keep; no Spanish title given.

hud.reel.note: Fishing sense, as in 'recoger el sedal' (reel the line in); same verb as the pass name Autorrecogida.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0 and 1 read correctly.

catch.success.note: Colon and parentheses keep articles and adjectives from agreeing with the inserted names (Carpa dorada and Anguila farol are feminine; rarity tags use the masculine standalone form, per the guide).

catch.escaped.note: 'It slipped away from you'; present perfect, the Spain form for something that just happened.

catch.new_record.note: Source-side issue: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Spain writes '12,4'. The game code should format the decimal comma; the translation cannot fix it.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name: 'farol' is the old-style lantern, keeping the glowing-lantern idea. 'Anguila linterna' (after the real 'pez linterna') also fits in 16, but 'linterna' reads as a flashlight in Spain.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine standalone tier tag (Raro, Épico, Legendario, Mítico) per the guide; ranks above Legendario.

shop.rods.note: Short for 'cañas de pescar' (15, over budget); the fishing shop makes the sense clear.

shop.equipped.note: State label agreeing with 'caña' (fem.), since it only shows on rods. If the label is ever reused on other items, 'En uso' is neutral.

pass.auto_reel.note: Noun from the Reel verb 'recoger' with the auto- prefix (like 'autoguardado'). 'Recogida automática' is clearer but 19, over the 14 budget; 'Recoger auto' would read as 'pick up the car'. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: ¡El Cebo de la suerte duplica tus probabilidades de sacar peces raros!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Article 'El' stays outside the bold pass name. 'sacar' = land a fish, avoiding the clunky 'pescar peces'; 'raros' matches the Raro tier.

sell.done.note: Label form because count and coins can each be 1 ('1 peces', '1 monedas' would be wrong). Less flowing than the English sentence; a native may prefer another plural-safe wording.

sell.prompt.note: Keeps E; 'Pulsa' is the Spain verb. Source-side issue: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText 'Vender' would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: Promotion/rank-up sense, not climbing or religious; same word as in ascend.confirm.

ascend.confirm.text: ¿Ascender ahora? Empezarás de cero, pero pescarás peces raros un {bonus} % más a menudo.
ascend.confirm.note: 'Empezarás de cero' = start over (rods and coins reset). Space before % per the guide.

weather.storm.text: ¡Se acerca una tormenta! Los peces raros están picando.
weather.storm.note: 'picar' = fish taking the bait, the fishing sense of 'biting'.

quest.catch_n.text: Captura peces en Bahía Lunar. Meta: {n}
quest.catch_n.note: Count after a colon because n can be 1 ('1 peces' would be wrong). 'Bahía Lunar' is the translated Moonlit Bay (terms.json); in-world signs must use the same name. 'Captura' avoids the clunky 'Pesca peces'.
quest.catch_n.review_reason: A bare number after a colon reads as a progress counter (the back-translator could not tell target from progress); labeling it Meta makes {n} the goal and stays plural-safe for n = 1, 36 of 40.

quest.claim.note: Collect the reward, per the guide's reward.claim reference.

friends.boost.text: Pescar con amigos te da +{percent} % de suerte
friends.boost.note: Statement, not an order. Space before % per the guide.

trade.sent.note: Restructured as 'You proposed a trade to {player}': 'Solicitud de intercambio enviada a' is 35, over the 33 budget. Neutral for any gender of {player}.

trade.accept.note: 'ha aceptado' never changes form, so it is safe for any gender of {player}.

afk.kicked.text: Has estado demasiado tiempo sin moverte, así que has dejado de pescar.
afk.kicked.note: 'sin moverte' instead of 'inactivo', which would agree with the player's gender. 'así que' makes the cause explicit, as the context describes it; no mention of leaving the server.

event.ends.note: Source-side issue: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; Spain writes '2 d 4 h', and minutes must be 'min' (m = meters). d and h read fine meanwhile.

daily.streak.text: ¡Día {day} de racha! Vuelve mañana a por más.
daily.streak.note: 'Día {day} de racha' works for day 1. 'a por más' is everyday Spain Spanish for 'to get more'.

tip.night.text: Consejo: algunos peces solo pican de noche.

group.join.text: ¡Únete a nuestra comunidad y llévate 50 cebos gratis!
group.join.note: 'comunidad' follows Roblox's Groups -> Communities rename (guide). 'nuestra' makes clear it is the studio's group, which bare 'la comunidad' would not.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Board title for the heaviest single fish; the weights on the board make the sense clear. 'Pez más pesado' (14) is the explicit alternative.
